# August 2026

> August 2026 release notes for Automation Cloud and Test Cloud.

## Automation Cloud Public Sector and Test Cloud Public Sector

### Late August 2026

| Publishing date | Release timeframe |
| --- | --- |
| August 31, 2026 | August 16, 2026 – August 31, 2026 |

#### Release highlights

The following sections outline some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud Public Sector and Test Cloud Public Sector in the August 16, 2026 – August 31, 2026 timeframe. For comprehensive release notes, refer to the individual platform or product release notes.

**Orchestrator**

* Azure Storage buckets can now be authenticated using Integration Service service-principal connections instead of storage-account access keys.
* Side panels now render on top of primary content instead of pushing it aside, and are resizable with a persisted width.
* The default API specification is now OpenAPI 3.0 Public profile; the previous V20/Swagger 2.0 specification is deprecated and will be removed in September 2026.

**Task Mining**

* Task Mining in Automation Cloud Public Sector is being retired, effective September 1, 2026, to redirect resources toward Delegate - Cartographer.

**Test Manager**

* The manual execution assistant now shows the test case description above **Precondition**. Excel export of requirements and test cases is now asynchronous with one column per custom field. The iText PDF library dependency was removed (breaking change: PDF attachments are now text-only in the cloud).
